'''Annual Events''' (年中行事, ねんちゅうぎょうじ or ねんじゅうぎょうじ) refer to events held at specific times each year. Narrowly, it can mean traditional matters, particularly court-related rituals, but broadly, it encompasses everything from personal events to nationwide and even global occurrences.
== Annual Events in Japan ==
Annual events in Japan are often tied to agricultural activities associated with the [[:en:four seasons|four seasons]]. Many have been shaped by the lives of the imperial court, {{ill|Nobility|ab|Аамсҭара|af|Adel|als|Adel|ar|نبل|ast|Nobleza|az|Zadəganlıq|ba|Дворянлыҡ|be|Знаць|be_x_old|Дваранства|bg|Аристокрация|bjn|Kasuma|br|Noblañs|bs|Plemstvo|ca|Noblesa|ckb|نەجیبزادەیی|cs|Šlechta|cv|Тăрăн|da|Adel|de|Adel|el|Ευγενείς|eo|Nobelaro|es|Nobleza|et|Aadel|eu|Noblezia|fa|نجیب‌زادگی|fi|Aateli|fr|Noblesse|frr|Aadel|fy|Eallju|ga|Uaisleacht|gan|貴族|gl|Nobreza|he|אצולה|hi|कुलीनवर्ग|hr|Plemstvo|hu|Nemesség|hy|Ազնվականություն|ia|Nobilitate|id|Bangsawan|ig|Onye isi|inh|Эздий|io|Nobeleso|is|Aðall|it|Nobiltà|ja|貴族|jv|Ningrat|ka|თავადაზნაურობა|ko|귀족|ku|Torinî|la|Nobilitas|lb|Adel|lmo|Nobiltà|lt|Diduomenė|lv|Dižciltīgie|min|Bangsawan|mk|Благородништво|mr|सामंतशाही|ms|Golongan bangsawan|myv|Мастачей|mzn|نوبرس|nds_nl|Adel|ne|भारदार परिवार|nl|Adel|nn|Adel|no|Adel|oc|Noblesa|pa|ਕੁਲੀਨਵਰਗ|pl|Szlachta|ps|اشرافیت / اشرافي خلک|pt|Nobreza|ro|Nobilime|ru|Дворянство|sh|Plemstvo|simple|Nobility|sk|Šľachta|sl|Plemstvo|sq|Fisnikëria|sr|Племство|sv|Adel|th|ชนชั้นขุนนาง|tl|Hadlika|tr|Asil|tt|Дворяннар|uk|Шляхта|uz|Dvoryanlar|vec|Nobiltà|vi|Giới quý tộc|wuu|贵族|za|Gveicuz|zh|貴族|zh_min_nan|Kùi-cho̍k|zh_yue|貴族|qid=Q134737|lt=nobility}}, and {{ill|bushi|ja|武士|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1975935}}, which have been absorbed into the lives of the common people.<ref>Hideo Haga, "Travels with Orikuchi Shinobu into Ancient Times," Keio University Press, 2009, pp. 94–103</ref>. Traditional events such as Tanabata are sometimes included here (Tanabata and Christmas are both considered traditional events).
